GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

4. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   B. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   C. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   B. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Soils as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   B. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   C. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   B. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   B. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   D. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

13. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

14. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.

15. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   C. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   B. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   C. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Weathering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Wasting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
